name: B10-0100/2024 (ECR) – The case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for all charges against Turkish journalist Bülent Mumay to be dropped immediately and unconditionally. He was sentenced to 20 months in prison over a social media post about a construction company that took Istanbul subway money. The Parliament also says press freedom in Türkiye is under constant pressure and that journalists face arbitrary charges. It asks Türkiye to revise its disinformation law so it is not used to punish the press.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its opinion and asks Türkiye to act.
- It concerns Bülent Mumay, other jailed journalists and Türkiye's media.
- The resolution is sent to Turkish and European Union institutions; no further steps are set out.
